### That God’s Name May Be Honored
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-name-may-be-honored
Passage: 1 Timothy 6:1
Points:
- Believers carry a vital duty to ensure God's holy name is not brought into disrepute.
- Unbelievers often judge the reality and truth of the gospel based on how Christians conduct themselves.
- Paul’s command for servants to respect their masters applies directly to how modern workers treat supervisors and leaders.
- Insubordination and disrespect from Christians give the world cause to mock and malign God.
- Diligently honoring authorities fulfills the call to revere the Lord's name and displays the transforming fruit of the gospel.
